item.title: Supreme Court declines 'Let's Go Brandon' case
item.description: The Supreme Court on Monday refused to hear a case involving public school students barred from wearing "Let's Go Brandon" sweatshirts to class.

item.title: DOJ files more noncitizen voting cases since September than in Biden's four years
item.description: The Justice Department announced three additional noncitizen voting cases in Louisiana on Monday.

item.title: Thom Tillis, with few accomplishments, sees himself as America's most important man
item.description: Tillis should be focused on pleasing his voters, not promoting his self-described GOP stardom.

item.title: Let Them Eat Aggregates
item.description: Despite seemingly good data, the economy still feels frozen to those who depend on wages—that is, most of us.
